overall_policy.description: Aberdeen publishes minimum academic requirements and requires all medicine applicants to complete UCAT. Stage 2 selection and offer rules remain incomplete.

grade_requirements.notes: GCSE English Language grade 6, or National 5 English grade B, is required.
GCSE Mathematics grade 6, or National 5 Mathematics grade B, is required.

gcse.notes: Biology and Physics are recommended but not compulsory.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One subject from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics is required.

grade_requirements.notes: Three A-levels must be taken together at first sitting over a maximum of two years.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Widening access A-level adjustment requires Chemistry plus one from Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

grade_requirements.notes: Widening access minimum for eligible applicants.

standard_offer.notes: Chemistry required, plus one from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics, and one further subject.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One subject from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics is required.

a_level.third_subject_rules: One further A-level in most other subjects. General Studies and Global Perspectives and Research are not accepted.
a_level.notes: Academic score is awarded on the basis of predicted or achieved A2 grades.

one_of_hl_subject_groups.notes: One of Mathematics, Biology or Physics is required at Higher Level.

grade_requirements.notes: 36 points overall including core, with three appropriate HL subjects at grade 6 and three appropriate SL subjects with an average of 6. If only two sciences are offered at HL, a further science subject at SL is required.

one_of_hl_subject_groups.notes: One of Mathematics, Biology or Physics is required at Higher Level.

ib.notes: Aberdeen accepts both Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation maths pathways. Maths Studies is not considered a science.

higher_offer.notes: Standard entry: five Highers at AAAAB.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Where S5 minimum requirements are not met, S6 programmes may include new Highers and/or Advanced Highers. See structured grade requirements and notes.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Two subjects are required from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics and Physics.

grade_requirements.notes: Normally AAAAB from five full academic courses at one sitting, from Highers and/or Advanced Highers.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Widening access adjusted entry requires Chemistry plus two from Biology/Human Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

grade_requirements.notes: Adjusted entry requirement for widening access applicants.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Two subjects are required from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics and Physics.

scottish.notes: Foundation Apprenticeships are accepted in some cases, but are not yet modelled as subject IDs.

post_16.notes: UK school-leaver academic requirements are now represented. Graduate, mature, EU and international academic routes need separate extraction before prediction for those groups.

ucat.notes: All applicants must complete UCAT by the appropriate closing date. Aberdeen states no minimum UCAT cut-off score is used; UCAT is scored relative to other Aberdeen applicants and considered for interview selection.

group_policies.notes: International applicants with SJT Band 4 are automatically ineligible for interview. Bands 1–3 are acceptable.

sjt.notes: The top-level policy remains unchanged for Home applicants. International applicants follow the separate verified group policy.

conditions: Applicants resitting exams to upgrade results are not normally considered unless very serious personal difficulties affected first sitting.
Extenuating circumstances must have been declared to the relevant exam board at the time of sitting.
AS module resits are permitted if the final three A-levels are undertaken simultaneously over two years of study.
resits.notes: Borderline cases and serious personal difficulties are considered under Aberdeen's extenuating circumstances policy.

accepted_tests.test: Cambridge English B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency

english_language.notes: English language requirements may apply to applicants whose first language is not English or who require English language evidence.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks usually apply; exact timing/wording needs verification.

international_selection.notes: International applicants are assessed in a completely separate ranking pool.

ranking_factors.notes: Aberdeen states applications are scored objectively by academic achievements/predictions at 30%. Full implementation deferred to Stage 2 modelling.
Aberdeen states UCAT score is weighted at 20% before interview. Full ranking model remains unverified.

score_components.notes: Official weighting verified: academic achievements/predictions contribute 30%. Exact academic scoring formula is unknown and not verified.

Official weighting verified: UCAT contributes 20%. Aberdeen states UCAT score is allocated based on overall performance compared with all other Aberdeen applicants, using the total numerical score from four subtests. Exact UCAT conversion formula is unknown and not verified.

total_score.notes: Official process verified: pre-interview selection combines academic and UCAT components, and highest scoring applicants are invited to interview. Exact component formulas are unknown.

calculation.notes: Calculation stores official weightings and process only. Exact academic scoring formula and UCAT conversion formula remain unknown.

selection_adjustments.notes: Stage 2 placeholder only. Aberdeen states 10% UCAT uplift for SIMD20 and/or care experienced school-leaving applicants.
Stage 2 placeholder only. Aberdeen states 5% UCAT uplift for SIMD40 school-leaving applicants.

output_band_policy.notes: Bands are ApplySmart interview guidance from official weighting, FOI conversion evidence and applicant-group historical data; they are not live cutoffs or probability percentages.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Stage 2 weighting and broad pre-interview selection process are official-source verified. Exact academic scoring and UCAT conversion formulas remain unknown. SJT policy remains unknown/not explicitly stated.

criteria.description: Home postcode in SIMD20 or SIMD40 postcode areas.
Care experienced or looked-after background at any stage in life.

adjustments.policy_description: Adjusted SQA minimum from S5 to AAAB, including Chemistry plus two from Biology/Human Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
Adjusted A-level minimum to AAB, including Chemistry plus one from Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

conditions: Applicant has achieved Aberdeen's minimum academic requirements.
Applicant's UCAT score is within the top 75% of scores of all applicants to Aberdeen.
